mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_cost_alert (tenant_id, period, period_key, alert_type, used_amount, limit_amount, forecast_amount, status, first_seen_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{period}, #{periodKey}, #{alertType}, #{usedAmount}, #{limitAmount}, #{forecastAmount}, #{status}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.perm_code = 'billing:view'
